milestones.name: Frozen Data and Artifact Integrity
milestones.description: Preserve the licensed fixed split and independently validate every required artifact while retaining the executable entrypoint contract.

criteria.description: Frozen split hashes, schemas, sizes, IDs, labels, and provenance are intact and disjoint.
A regular /app/run.py entrypoint is present in the fresh task environment and the independently checked artifact set is complete.
Every required checkpoint, TorchScript export, prediction, metric, history, GPU-evidence, and report artifact exists and is nonempty.

milestones.name: PPGN Model and Hidden Evaluation
milestones.description: Produce a real order-2 PPGN, valid frozen-split predictions, independently recomputable metrics, and invariant executable exports.

criteria.description: The checkpoint is loadable, finite, nontrivial, semantically identifies an order-2 PPGN with a quadratic matrix product, and records CUDA training.
The quadratic-free ablation checkpoint is loadable, finite, nontrivial, records the same 7,050-step CUDA budget, and is identified as order-2 without a matrix product.
Primary and ablation predictions exactly cover their frozen splits and every reported validation metric matches an independent recomputation.
CUDA TorchScript replay matches saved hidden-test predictions, remains permutation invariant, and independently reproduces both expressivity classifiers.
GPU evidence records exactly one CUDA device, positive optimizer steps for every experiment, positive peak CUDA allocation, and elapsed runtime.

milestones.name: Analysis and Reproducibility
milestones.description: Explain the licensed data, PPGN design, ablation, expressivity result, CUDA execution, quadratic cost, and limitations.

criteria.description: The report is substantive and covers every required provenance, method, result, reproducibility, compute, and limitation topic.
